items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 37:1
items.html: (To the question) For those posteriors that fell from AVI are the aspect of the MAN that AVI received from the Yesod of AK, and therefore, after they fell to the place of ZON, ZON raises them back as MAN to AVI, from all the levels within them, which are NRNHY. (p. 529, s.v. "the raising of MAN")
